settings.languageHint: Applies to every screen and is saved in this browser.

users.subtitle: Individual accounts for your local network.

library.visibility: New problems are visible only to administrators until a contest containing them starts.
problem.newHint: Add a statement, examples, and limits to save a problem to the library.
problem.translationHint: One language is sufficient. Missing translations are clearly indicated.
problem.textHint: Plain text. HTML is not executed. Upload a PDF for a formatted statement.
problem.pdfHint: Up to 5 MB per file. PDFs are stored on the server and available for download.
problem.testsLater: After creating the problem, add hidden tests on its page.
problem.missingTranslation: Translation unavailable. Choose another statement language or download an available PDF.
problem.loadError: Could not upload the PDF. Check the file format and size.
validation.problemTitle: Provide a title in at least one language, up to 100 characters.
validation.statement: Provide a statement in at least one language or upload a PDF.
validation.problemText: Each text field must contain no more than 20,000 characters.
validation.pdf: Only PDFs with a %PDF- header, up to 5 MB, are accepted.
contest.confirmFinish: Finish early? The contest will move to results.
contest.startHint: Starting makes problems visible to participants and freezes the saved tests and limits for this contest.
contest.invalidTransition: The contest status has changed or this action is unavailable. Refresh the page.
contest.needsProblems: Add at least one problem before starting the contest.
standings.chooseTitle: Every contest has its own story
standings.chooseHint: Select a completed contest to view its final standings.
standings.noCompleted: There are no completed contests yet.
standings.noResultsHint: No solutions have been submitted to this contest.
standings.unavailable: This contest is not completed or is not accessible.
standings.pointsLegend: Sum of best problem scores; a problem is worth up to 100 points with test weights and groups applied. Equal scores are ordered by the earliest time that total was reached. Equal times share a rank.
chat.title: Chat with administrator
chat.hint: Private conversation with the organizers. Updates every 5 seconds.
chat.limit: Up to 2000 characters · latest 100 messages shown
admin.dashboardHint: Prepare competitions and manage your workspace.
tests.private: Hidden tests are administrator-only. Scheduled contests pick up saved changes immediately; snapshots of contests that have started change only through a rejudge.
tests.conflict: Another editor changed this suite. Copy your changes and reload the page.
tests.importHint: Import replaces the editor list. Click Save to persist. Up to 100 tests, 256 KB per field, 4 MB per suite. Points (0–1000) and Group are optional. Format:
tests.title: Problem tests
tests.empty: Add a test or import JSON.
tests.invalid: Invalid suite: JSON array of Input/Output objects, up to 100 tests, 256 KB per field, 4 MB total. Fields must be strings without null characters.
judge.fileHint: UTF-8, up to 64 KB. The file replaces the editor contents.
judge.fileError: Choose a non-empty UTF-8 source file up to 64 KB.
judge.loaded: File loaded. Review the code and submit.
judge.supported: C++, C#, Java, Python, Go, Haskell and JavaScript are available. The checking method is shown with the statement; by default answers are compared as tokens.
judge.invalid: Select a supported language and non-empty source up to 64 KB.
judge.queueFull: You already have three pending submissions. Please wait.
judge.contestClosed: Contest is closed or the selected language is not allowed.
judge.noTests: No saved tests for this problem. Add tests for every problem before starting the contest.
queue.title: Judge queue
queue.subtitle: Service status and recent participant submissions.
queue.offlineHint: No Worker is online. Submissions remain queued until one starts.
queue.limit: Latest 50 matching submissions. Counters cover the entire queue. The list updates as soon as anything changes.
judge.memory: This problem's memory limit is too low for this language: Java requires at least 128 MB, C# and JavaScript 64 MB.
judge.entry: One source file, standard library only. Java: class Main without package; C#: Main or top-level code; Go: package main; Haskell: main; JavaScript: Node.js / CommonJS.
rejudge.title: Rejudge
rejudge.warning: Results are cleared until judging finishes. Submission times and source code stay unchanged. Updated tests apply to the entire contest, including future submissions.
rejudge.historyHint: Latest 20 runs. Previous verdicts and tests are retained in the database for audit.
rejudge.invalid: Check the rejudge reason and parameters.
rejudge.contest: Select a real started or finished contest.
freeze.live: Live results. Click Refresh to retrieve new verdicts.
freeze.adminHint: Participant standings are frozen. You see current results. Snapshot at
freeze.participantHint: Standings are frozen. Showing the snapshot at
freeze.invalid: Only a started real contest can be frozen.
tests.creationHint: Hidden tests for judging solutions. Participants cannot see them. Include public examples in the statement or PDF.
tests.editorHint: Add input and expected output pairs. Type text or upload two TXT files per test. UTF-8, up to 256 KB per file, 100 tests and 4 MB total. Upload replaces only the selected field; whitespace and line endings are preserved.
tests.txtInvalid: Could not load the file. Use a UTF-8 TXT file up to 256 KB without null characters.
problem.deleteHint: The problem, PDFs and hidden tests will be permanently deleted. Only custom problems without contest references or submissions can be deleted.
problem.deleteUsed: This problem belongs to a contest or has submissions. It cannot be deleted because its statement and result history must remain available.
users.createHint: Enter a login and name. A 6-character password will be generated automatically.
users.credentialsHint: Download the TXT and give it to the participant. The password cannot be viewed again after closing this card.
users.participantPasswordRules: Participant password: exactly 6 characters, at least 3 distinct characters.
users.deleteHint: The account will no longer be able to sign in and existing sessions will lose access. Submissions and results remain. This account cannot be restored; reusing its login creates a new participant.
users.deleteAdmin: Administrators and your own account cannot be deleted.
users.notFound: Account already deleted or not found.
standings.timeHint: Elapsed time from contest start (hh:mm:ss): the first submission reaching a problem’s best positive score; the participant time is when the final total was reached. Submission time is used, not judging completion. Attempts count all submissions, including compilation errors and pending runs; they do not break ties. “—” means no result or unavailable data in an older snapshot.
enrollment.title: Contest participants
enrollment.hint: Select the users who can access this contest.
enrollment.invalid: Select active participant accounts without duplicates and within the capacity limit.
enrollment.empty: No participants yet. Create accounts in Users & access.
enrollment.unavailable: Account deleted or disabled — uncheck it.
enrollment.none: You are not enrolled in any contest
enrollment.contact: The organizer needs to enroll you in a contest. This page updates automatically.
schedule.title: Start time
schedule.hint: Enter the time in the selected time zone. Leave blank when creating a draft. Scheduling requires tests for every problem; their snapshot is saved when scheduling.
schedule.invalid: Choose a future start time within one year.
schedule.noDate: The organizer has not scheduled the start yet.
schedule.locked: Problems and standings will become available automatically when the contest starts.
checker.title: Answer checking
checker.hint: How program output is compared with the hidden test answers.
checker.tokensHint: Words and numbers must match; whitespace and line breaks between them are ignored.
checker.linesHint: Lines must match exactly; trailing spaces and trailing empty lines are ignored.
checker.floatHint: Tokens are compared as in token mode; numbers within an absolute or relative error ε: |x − y| ≤ ε · max(1, |y|).
checker.testlibHint: A C++ program using testlib.h runs as checker input.txt output.txt answer.txt in its own sandbox. Exit code 0 means correct, 1 and 2 wrong answer, anything else is a checker failure (System error verdict). Limits: 15 seconds and 512 MB per run.
checker.invalidMode: Choose a checking method from the list.
checker.sourceInvalid: A custom checker needs non-empty UTF-8 C++ source up to 64 KB.
problem.editHint: Statement, PDF, limits and checking method. Tests are edited on their own page.
problem.editSnapshots: Scheduled contests pick up new limits and checking immediately. Running and finished contests keep their snapshot: to apply changes there, rejudge the contest with updated tests.
tests.zipHint: The archive replaces the editor list; click Save to persist. File pairs are matched by name and sorted by number. Weights and groups can be set after import. Up to 16 MB archive, 100 tests, 256 KB per file and 4 MB total, UTF-8. Supported names:
tests.zipInvalid: Cannot read the archive: a ZIP of UTF-8 text files within the limits is required.
tests.zipDuplicate: The archive contains two files for the same test.
tests.zipUnpaired: No input/answer pairs were found, or some tests have no pair.
tests.pointsHint: Test weights apply in points contests: a problem result is the earned share of 100. Tests in one group count only together. Sample tests can be worth 0.
tests.pointsInvalid: Test points are an integer from 0 to 1000; a group is up to 32 Latin letters, digits, '-' or '_'.
tests.pointsTotal: The total points of all tests must be greater than zero.
